## Answer: 6992

**Setup.** Place the center at the origin $O$ and use Eisenstein coordinates $a+b\omega$, $\omega=e^{i\pi/3}$. The lattice vertices are the points with $|a|,|b|,|a+b|\le 4$, giving $3\cdot4\cdot5+1=61$ points. Excluding $O$ leaves 60 points. Any triangle with $O$ as a vertex does not contain $O$ strictly inside, so only these 60 points matter.

**Criterion.** $O$ lies strictly inside triangle $ABC$ if and only if no closed half-plane bounded by a line through $O$ contains all three vertices. Two vertices on the same ray from $O$ always put $O$ outside or on the boundary, so only triples on three distinct rays can count.

**Rays.** The 60 points lie on 36 rays. Each $60^\circ$ sector $[60k^\circ, 60k^\circ+60^\circ)$ contains six rays, with angles and point-counts (weights):

| Angle offset | 0° | 13.9° | 19.1° | 30° | 40.9° | 46.1° |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Weight | 4 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 1 |

The six sectors together give 60 points. The weight pattern is invariant under rotation by $180^\circ$, so rays come in antipodal pairs with equal weight.

**Counting.** Let $T$ be the number of triples on three distinct rays (weighted by point multiplicities). This is the elementary symmetric polynomial $e_3$ of the 36 weights, with
- $p_1=\sum w = 60$,
- $p_2=\sum w^2 = 6\cdot 24 = 144$,
- $p_3=\sum w^3 = 6\cdot 76 = 456$.

So $T = \dfrac{p_1^3-3p_1p_2+2p_3}{6} = \dfrac{216000-25920+912}{6} = 31832$.

A bad distinct-ray triple lies in a closed semicircle. It has exactly one gap $\ge 180^\circ$, so it has a unique "first" ray $p$, with the other two rays in the arc $(\theta_p,\theta_p+180^\circ]$. That arc contains exactly one ray from each antipodal pair, i.e. 18 consecutive rays. For each $p$:
- total weight in the arc $=\tfrac{60}{2}=30$,
- sum of squared weights in the arc $=\tfrac{144}{2}=72$,
- weighted pairs in the arc $=\dfrac{30^2-72}{2}=414$.

Hence the bad weighted count is $\sum_p w_p\cdot 414 = 60\cdot 414 = 24840$.

**Result.**
$$\#\{\text{triangles with } O \text{ strictly inside}\} = T - 24840 = 31832-24840 = 6992.$$

ANSWER: 6992
